profile_text.body:
Credo AI, founded in 2020, describes itself as the trusted leader in AI governance. The company's platform operationalizes governance across AI models, agents, and applications, helping enterprises discover their AI systems, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk. Credo AI states it created the AI governance category and is now defining it for what the company calls the agentic era, with capabilities including agent registry, agentic risk controls, and governance integrated across existing technology stacks.

The platform includes policy packs containing regulatory intelligence for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards. Credo AI notes its team contributed to standards development at ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD. The company also offers GAIA, an AI assistant built into the platform, and emphasizes native integrations across 300+ systems. According to customer testimonials on the site, users report accelerated compliance timelines, with one noting the platform accelerated EU AI Act compliance by at least 10x compared to manual efforts.

Credo AI's product is categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform, purpose-built for governance with policy packs and fast deployment capability. The company works with enterprises across insurance, financial services, federal, and healthcare sectors, including named customers such as Mastercard and IBM.
